data.title: An information panel at the hillfort of Malý Manín
data.excerpt: The Hradiská civic association, together with the town of Považská Bystrica, put up an information panel at the hillfort of the Lusatian and Púchov cultures on Malý Manín in the cadastral area of the village of Považská Teplá. The text was prepared with the expert help of the archaeologist of the Považie Museum in Žilina, Andrea Slaná.

children.text: This weekend our Hradiská civic association, in cooperation with the town of Považská Bystrica, undertook its last event of the year – putting up an information panel at the
hillfort of the Lusatian and Púchov cultures on Malý Manín
(the cadastral area of the village of Považská Teplá).

With the text we were helped on the expert side by the archaeologist of the Považie Museum in Žilina, Mrs Andrea Slaná, who also provided us from the museum store with a good photograph of one of the finds from the hillfort (a small axe of the Púchov culture, which was found by Gašpar Zemančík and handed over to the museum).

The town of Považská Bystrica played a significant part in preparing the installation of the panel, above all the former deputy mayor Marián Sopčák and the head of the mayor's office Michal Hamár, both through their helpful attitude to our plan and through their assistance in dealing with the Protected Landscape Area administration. The town of Považská Bystrica has also promised to reimburse the cost of producing the panel, for which it has our great thanks in advance.

children.text: Also not to be missed at the installation of the panel were Mr Ladislav Janech – the discoverer of the hillfort and a local enthusiast who has a private museum in Považská Teplá – and Mr Gašpar Zemančík, who took part in the excavation of the hillfort.

Everyone who helped us with the installation has our enormous thanks for the effort they put in and for their support. We trust that the panel will serve tourists for as long as possible and that it will not fall victim to vandals.
